name: Bezai
overview: Bezai was a male figure known primarily for his descendants who returned to Judah after the Babylonian captivity. While specific tribal affiliation and additional personal details are not recorded, his significance lies in his family's participation in the restoration of the Jewish community in Jerusalem following exile.
namesAndTitles: Bezai is the singular proper name recorded for this individual. No specific meaning or divine origin is attributed to the name in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Bezai as a descendant of Jacob, establishing his place within the broader covenantal lineage of Israel. Beyond this, the primary familial note is that his sons returned from captivity, but no further family details are provided.
scriptureSignificance: Bezai's importance in Scripture is tied to the post-exilic restoration period, highlighting the faithfulness of his descendants in returning to Judah to rebuild and renew the community. This connection underscores God's ongoing covenant with the descendants of Jacob and His providential care in preserving His people through the trials of captivity.
